reader_summary.overview: This week we are replaying our episode with Doug Leone. Doug led one of the world’s most successful venture firms, Sequoia, for over 25 years after he was given responsibility for the firm by its founder. Alongside Mike Moritz, the pair managed its expansion from a single $150m early-stage fund into an $85 billion global powerhouse.

key_points.text: Doug led one of the world’s most successful venture firms, Sequoia.
It was a privilege to sit down with Doug and learn from him.
We talk about his tough start at Sequoia, get into the technicalities of great go-to-market motions.
